research.companyOverview: Novartis Innovation represents the R&D, digital health, and corporate experiential marketing arms of Novartis, a top-tier global pharmaceutical company. The organization frequently deploys enterprise-scale budgets at major medical congresses and public events, utilizing cutting-edge immersive technologies—such as AR, VR, and massive LED installations—to drive physician empathy, visualize complex mechanisms of action (MOAs), and elevate brand resonance.
research.eventAgendaSummary:
Trade Shows:
- ASCO - American Society of Clinical Oncology (May/June, Chicago): Mega Exhibitor (e.g., Booth #19035 in 2025). Superside angle: Develop a 3D mixed-reality narrative similar to their past 'ReThinkCML' AR mirror to demonstrate new oncology mechanisms.
- ESMO - European Society for Medical Oncology (Sept/Oct, Europe): Major Exhibitor (e.g., Booth 3012). Superside angle: Design scalable interactive touchscreen modules for pipeline storytelling.
- AHA Scientific Sessions (Nov): Exhibitor. Superside angle: Create synchronized, multi-screen LED video content to drive traffic.

Marketing Events:
- Eurovision Song Contest (May 2025, Basel): Official Partner. Superside angle: Design 'sound of science' interactive kinetic walls or AI video generators for high-traffic public brand activations.
- Milan Design Week (Historical Flagship): Sponsor. Superside angle: Build VR overstimulation rooms to physically immerse audiences in the realities of neurological conditions.

Client/Customer Events:
- HCP Peer-to-Peer (P2P) Engagement Programs (Year-round): Organizer. Superside angle: Produce high-fidelity 3D MOA animations for tablet-based sales details and regional customer summits.

Internal Events:
- The GARAGE by iLab (Year-round, Corporate HQ): Host/Organizer. Superside angle: Facilitate AR/VR hackathons or supply generative AI content tools for internal innovation workshops and associate training.

Cadence/Seasonality:
- Major event spikes occur in late spring/early summer (ASCO, EHA, public sponsorships) and early fall (ESMO, AHA). Event planning cycles for these mega-congresses likely initiate 9 to 12 months in advance, making Q3/Q4 prime pitching windows for the following summer.
research.eventBudgetEstimate: Estimated >$15M+ annually. Novartis executes mega-island footprints at global medical congresses, builds zero-energy LED architectural pavilions (Novartis Pavillon), and sponsors major consumer events like Eurovision 2025 with custom 150 sqm immersive installations, indicating a massive experiential marketing and exhibit budget.
research.boothFootprint: Massive island footprints at major congresses (estimated >2,500 sq ft alongside peers like AstraZeneca at ASCO). Publicly verified footprints include a 150 sqm (approx. 1,600 sq ft) interactive brand experience booth at the Eurovision Song Contest 2025.
research.experientialActivations: Highly sophisticated. Novartis created the 'ReThinkCML' AR mirror at ASCO 2024, simulating patients holding heavy boulders to induce HCP empathy. They sponsored Eurovision 2025 with a 'Sound of Science' booth featuring kinetic walls, sound showers, and AI-assisted brand films. They also developed VR experiences simulating microaggressions for breast cancer patients.
research.creativeTechnologyUsage: Extensive use of AR (mobile MOA models, skeleton-tracking magic mirrors), VR (disease state empathy simulators, The GARAGE innovation lab), AI video generation, kinetic walls, and massive LED architectures (Novartis Pavillon's 30,000 LED facade; 13-surface LED trade show booths).

research.opportunityHypothesis: Novartis already possesses an incredibly mature appetite for immersive storytelling, heavily investing in AR mirrors, VR empathy tools, and AI-driven brand films. Superside can bypass basic awareness pitches and directly sell high-end 3D MOA content, mixed-reality technical execution, and scalable digital activations that plug seamlessly into their massive existing footprints at oncology and cardiology congresses.
research.successPotentialRationale: Rank 9 out of 10. Novartis has proven enterprise budgets, an established pattern of buying cutting-edge AR/VR/LED experiences for major trade shows (ASCO, Eurovision), and dedicated internal innovation hubs (The GARAGE). Their heavy reliance on external creative agencies for complex 3D and experiential work makes them a highly qualified, immediate-fit target for Superside.

research.companyOverview: Dayforce is a global human capital management (HCM) software company (formerly known as Ceridian) that provides a comprehensive cloud platform combining HR, payroll, benefits, workforce management, and talent management. Operating globally, the company recently rebranded from Ceridian to Dayforce to unify its identity and simplify the customer experience.
research.eventAgendaSummary:
Trade Shows:
- HR Technology Conference & Expo (Fall, Las Vegas) - Exhibitor (Booth 5515). Immersive Idea: High-fidelity 3D anamorphic booth displays showcasing the unified HCM platform.
- SHRM State Conferences (August, AZ) - Sponsor/Exhibitor. Immersive Idea: A dynamic AR lead capture experience triggered by scanning badges.
- UNLEASH World (Fall, Europe) - Exhibitor/Speaker. Immersive Idea: AI-focused interactive touch-screens demystifying Dayforce's AI capabilities.

Marketing Events:
- Dayforce Virtual Summit (June, Virtual) - Host. Immersive Idea: Broadcast-quality 3D motion graphics packages and virtual interactive sponsor booths.
- Phase 3 AI Executive Briefing (May, London) - Partner/Sponsor. Immersive Idea: Custom digital presentation decks with embedded interactive ROI calculators.

Client/Customer Events:
- Dayforce Discover (October, Las Vegas) - Host. Immersive Idea: Expansion of the prior Superside AR activation into a spatial computing/VR environment showcasing Dayforce FIT training capabilities.
- Dayforce Summit Roadshow (June & August, Dallas & Chicago) - Host. Immersive Idea: Scalable, modular interactive demo pods that travel from city to city.

Internal Events:
- Dayforce Sales Kickoff (January, Las Vegas) - Host. Immersive Idea: High-energy opening sizzle reels and immersive stage content for keynote presentations.

Cadence/Seasonality:
The year kicks off with internal SKOs in January. The summer (June-August) features a heavy rotation of regional roadshows. Major third-party trade shows peak in late summer/early fall (SHRM, HR Tech), serving as a lead-up to their flagship customer conference, Dayforce Discover, which anchors the mid-to-late October timeframe. Note: LinkedIn was checked but no usable public event evidence was found to supplement.
research.eventBudgetEstimate: High 7-figure to low 8-figure estimated annual event budget. This is justified by their massive footprint at the Wynn Las Vegas for Dayforce Discover (over 3,000 attendees, 50+ partner booths, full custom build-outs), large island booths at top-tier industry trade shows like HR Tech, multi-city regional roadshows, and large-scale internal SKOs at premium Vegas venues.
research.boothFootprint: Massive event footprint. At Dayforce Discover, they utilize 50+ partner booths, 15 product stations, 2 demo theaters, and 3 customer activations across the Wynn Cristal Ballroom. At third-party events like HR Tech 2025, they occupied a large island space (Booth 5515).
research.experientialActivations: For their recent rebrand at the INSIGHTS/Discover conference in Las Vegas, Dayforce deployed an interactive Augmented Reality (AR) experience featuring 3D objects, augmented animations, an AR stand, target tracking, and face filters to reveal the new unified brand. Their customer events also feature large digital brand-experience walls and experiential product stations.
research.creativeTechnologyUsage: Augmented Reality (AR), 3D animation, face filtering, interactive product demonstration screens, scalable digital content walls, and large-scale digital presentation graphics.

Superside can partner alongside them to deliver the digital screen content, AR/VR layers, and interactive UI without stepping on their fabrication scope.

agencyPartnerAnalysis.scope: AR, motion design, digital experiences, and brand unveilings

agencyPartnerAnalysis.evidence: Superside's own website features a case study on their AR work for the Ceridian-to-Dayforce rebrand at their customer conference.

agencyPartnerAnalysis.role: Trade show labor and logistics provider
agencyPartnerAnalysis.scope: Trade show labor, installation, and event execution
agencyPartnerAnalysis.experientialRelevance: Willwork handles on-site setup for Dayforce events. Superside's physical/digital activations will likely interact with Willwork's labor constraints, emphasizing the need for easily deployable or purely digital experiential tech.
agencyPartnerAnalysis.evidence: Willwork lists 'Dayforce Discover' as one of the major events for which they provide trusted trade show services.

research.opportunityHypothesis: Since Superside already successfully delivered an AR activation for Dayforce's rebrand at their flagship event, Superside has proven equity in Dayforce's experiential portfolio. By pitching high-fidelity 3D motion graphics, expanded spatial computing/AR experiences, and interactive demo interfaces that integrate smoothly with Elevation3D’s physical builds, Superside can secure recurring creative retainers for the massive Dayforce Discover conference, regional roadshows, and major external trade shows like HR Tech.
research.successPotentialRationale: 9/10. Dayforce invests massively in experiential events and has a proven track record of buying creative technology (AR filters/tracking) directly from Superside. Their existing partner ecosystem focuses heavily on physical fabrication, leaving a clear, unthreatened lane for Superside to expand its digital interactive, XR, and screen content footprint at their flagship Discover conference and regional roadshows.

research.companyOverview: Palo Alto Networks is the world's largest pure-play cybersecurity company, providing next-generation firewalls, cloud security, and AI-powered security operations. Executing a major 'platformization' strategy, they leverage massive global events to consolidate enterprise security tools and target IT decision-makers and CISOs.
research.eventAgendaSummary:
Trade Shows:
- RSA Conference (RSAC) (Spring, San Francisco): Exhibitor/Speaker. Superside could provide animated 3D product visualizations for multi-station demo pods.
- Black Hat USA (August, Las Vegas): Exhibitor/Sponsor/NOC Provider. Superside could design interactive gamified SecOps stations to drive booth traffic.
- AWS re:Inforce (June, Philadelphia): Exhibitor. Superside could create localized digital campaign assets to drive pre-show registration.

Marketing Events:
- Ignite on Tour (Feb-May, Global Roadshow - Sydney, Johannesburg, Madrid, New York): Host/Organizer. Superside could scale keynote presentation designs and regionalized digital signage for field marketing teams.

Client/Customer Events:
- Executive Brand Sponsorships & Hospitality (Year-round, Elite sports arenas): Host. Superside could design premium, high-touch interactive AR invitations or VIP lounge graphics.

Internal Events:
- P.I.E.F.E.S.T. & Secure the Future Competition (Spring/Year-round, Santa Clara HQ): Host. Superside could provide employer branding collateral and internal digital event assets.

Cadence/Seasonality:
- Q1/Q2 is dominated by the Ignite on Tour global roadshow and RSAC. Late summer peaks with Black Hat USA, followed by continuous regional field activations and executive hospitality events throughout the year.
research.eventBudgetEstimate: Estimated in the robust 8-figure range annually. Palo Alto Networks reports over $700 million in quarterly sales and marketing expenses. Their newly formed 'Global Events Center of Excellence' manages massive scale, including the multi-city Ignite on Tour roadshow, 'high-tier global creative agencies', and massive 1500+ sq ft footprint sponsorships at major industry trade shows like RSAC and Black Hat.
research.boothFootprint: Known to utilize 30x40 and 30x50 island booths (1,200 - 1,500 sq ft) at flagship trade shows, integrating multiple presentation theaters, dedicated meeting rooms, and demo counters.
research.experientialActivations: Heavy use of experiential zones within booths, including AI Photo Activations, SecOps Gaming Stations, and integrated juice/cocktail bars. They also established a dedicated Brand Sponsorships and Hospitality unit to drive high-impact physical brand presence at elite sports arenas, and faced PR scrutiny over objectifying brand ambassador stunts delivered by Champagne Creative Group at Black Hat 2025.
research.creativeTechnologyUsage: They utilize interactive touchscreens, VR/AR gamified content, and AI photo booths for event lead capture. Internally, they deployed Aruba Meridian IoT beacon networks to create smart, interactive indoor experiences for employees at their Santa Clara HQ.

research.companyOverview: Booking.com, part of Booking Holdings, is a leading global travel and hospitality e-commerce platform. The company's Global Events unit executes a high-budget, multi-tiered event strategy that includes exhibiting at major travel trade shows, producing massive B2B partner summits (the 'Click.' series), and launching high-profile consumer experiential activations aligned with major cultural sponsorships like UEFA, Eurovision, and World Pride.
research.eventAgendaSummary:
Trade Shows:
- Business Travel Show Europe (June 2026, London, Exhibitor - Stand H20). Superside angle: Interactive, touch-screen product demos to capture B2B leads for Booking.com for Business.
- ITB Berlin (March, Berlin, Exhibitor). Superside angle: An immersive AR destination portal to draw foot traffic into their pavilion.
- GBTA Convention (Summer, Global, Exhibitor). Superside angle: A dynamic digital content wall visualizing corporate travel ROI data.

Marketing Events:
- Sydney World Pride (Feb/March, Sydney, Sponsor/Activation). Superside angle: Gamified mobile UGC filters for festival-goers to share their travel stories.
- Eurovision Song Contest (May, Europe, Sponsor/Activation). Superside angle: High-fidelity XR photo ops matching the vibrant Eurovision theme for influencer sharing.

Client/Customer Events:
- Click. EMEA (May 2025, Amsterdam, Host). Superside angle: High-end 3D motion graphics and projection mapping for the main keynote stage.
- Click. APAC (September 2025, Bali, Host). Superside angle: Gamified interactive partner awards experience.
- Click. Americas (Feb/March, Miami, Host). Superside angle: Sports-themed XR interactive challenges mimicking their WNBA activations.

Internal Events:
- Experimentation Conference (May 2025, Amsterdam Campus, Host). Superside angle: Digital wayfinding and branded data visualization boards for internal product teams.

Cadence/Seasonality:
Booking.com's event calendar is heavily front-loaded in the Spring (February to May), which houses the European and Americas editions of 'Click.', major trade shows like ITB Berlin, and cultural sponsorships like Eurovision. A secondary surge occurs in Autumn (September-November) for regional events like Click. APAC and major industry fairs like WTM London.
research.eventBudgetEstimate: High (7-figures+). The execution of multi-region, multi-day flagship conferences (Click.), alongside bespoke experiential builds (glowing LED suitcases for World Pride, 'Make a Splash' immersive projection rooms) and tier-one global sponsorships, indicates a multi-million dollar annual experiential budget.
research.boothFootprint: Large island/peninsula booths at major shows (e.g., Stand H20 at Business Travel Show Europe); specific square footage is unknown, but footprints regularly accommodate massive integrated LED builds, private meeting areas, and interactive sports pop-ups.
research.experientialActivations: Highly sophisticated. Recent executions include a custom oversized glowing suitcase with an integrated LED screen and automated video booth for World Pride; the 'Make a Splash' immersive room with interactive projections at Click 2024; a bespoke influencer experience for 800 guests at Eurovision; and a live basketball-themed interactive moment for the WNBA at Click 2025.

research.companyOverview: Lyft is a prominent mobility network and software company offering ride-hailing services, micromobility options like bikes and scooters, and enterprise solutions. Through divisions such as Lyft Business and Lyft Urban Solutions, the company targets B2B partnerships, corporate travel, and urban transit systems. Furthermore, Lyft operates a high-growth advertising division called Lyft Ads, which acts as an experiential marketing partner for external brands, offering out-of-home car wraps and geo-fenced in-app takeovers during major cultural and sporting events. Their event strategy is twofold: exhibiting at B2B auto and urban planning trade shows while aggressively executing consumer-facing brand activations, festival sponsorships, and field marketing.
research.eventAgendaSummary:
Trade Shows:
- NADA Show (Winter, Las Vegas): Exhibitor via Lyft Business (Booth 7508N). Support angle: Design a 3D digital simulation or interactive dashboard showing auto dealers how Lyft loaner rides operate logistically.
- Smart City Expo World Congress (November, Barcelona, Spain): Exhibitor via Lyft Urban Solutions. Support angle: Create an immersive XR showcase of the new Lyft Astro ebike within a futuristic urban digital twin.

Marketing Events:
- Big Game Week / Super Bowl (February, San Francisco): Marketing Activation partnering with Google Gemini. Support angle: Design hyper-localized interactive AR filters that riders unlock when taking a sponsored ride.
- Coachella & Stagecoach Festivals (Spring, Indio, CA): Activation Partner via Lyft Ads. Support angle: Produce high-end digital motion graphics for wrapped vehicle fleets, pairing physical wraps with dynamic in-app ads.
- Gov Ball Music Festival (June, New York City): Sponsor & Lounge Host. Support angle: Develop interactive social media walls and aesthetic 3D wayfinding elements for the Lyft Lounge.

Client/Customer Events:
- Advertising Week NY (October, New York City): Speaker & Sponsor via Lyft Ads. Support angle: Create cinematic opening videos and engaging presentation design for Lyft Ads executives presenting case studies to ad buyers.

Internal Events:
- Corporate Culture & Internal Celebrations (Ongoing, Various locations): Host. Support angle: Provide end-to-end presentation design and cinematic video production for company all-hands and internal kickoffs.

Cadence/Seasonality:
B2B trade shows are clustered in early Q1 (NADA) and late Q4 (Smart City Expo). Consumer marketing and festival activations peak during major sporting events in February and the summer music festival season from May to July. Next expected window for B2B show planning is mid-summer.
research.eventBudgetEstimate: Substantial multi-million dollar budget. Evidence indicates Lyft deploys significant capital for global trade show exhibits (e.g., Smart City Expo in Europe), nationwide street team activations across 6+ major markets, and large-scale experiential festival lounges. They also invest heavily in agency partners for internal events and regional PR activations.
research.boothFootprint: Unknown exact square footage, but presence ranges from standard B2B inline/island booths at NADA to multi-vehicle physical showcases at Smart City Expo, and large outdoor lounges at festivals.
research.experientialActivations: Lyft's experiential presence is extensive. They hosted the 'Lyft Lounge' with charging stations and branded touchpoints at Gov Ball 2025. Through Lyft Ads, they execute massive brand activations like wrapping 18 vehicles for NYX Makeup at Coachella/Stagecoach and deploying branded e-bikes with Google Gemini during Big Game week 2026. They also partner on local cultural activations, such as 'Murals On The Move' in Philadelphia.
research.creativeTechnologyUsage: Lyft integrates physical experiences with advanced digital technology. They utilize dynamic in-app map takeovers and geo-fenced digital couponing tied to physical locations and wrapped vehicles. Agencies also provide cinematic productions and digital storytelling for their corporate events.

research.companyOverview: Syngenta NA Crop Protection is the North American division of Syngenta Group, a leading global agribusiness. They specialize in crop protection chemicals, seeds, and digital agricultural solutions. To reach farmers, dealers, and agronomists, Syngenta maintains a massive, highly strategic presence at major North American agricultural trade shows, utilizing both large indoor island booths and sprawling outdoor field-show footprints.
research.eventAgendaSummary:
Trade Shows:
- Commodity Classic (February/March, e.g., San Antonio TX 2026) - Exhibitor/Sponsor. Superside angle: High-end 3D motion graphics for LED screens to visualize chemical modes of action at the molecular level inside the booth.
- National Farm Machinery Show (February, Louisville KY) - Exhibitor. Superside angle: Interactive touchscreen stations explaining product yield data and regional seed traits.
- Farm Progress Show (August, Decatur IL / Boone IA) - Major Exhibitor. Superside angle: AR field-tour applications that allow growers to use iPads to visualize root growth and nematode protection in real-time at the outdoor demo plots.
- Husker Harvest Days (September, Grand Island NE) - Exhibitor. Superside angle: Digital passport gamification app to drive traffic between the main exhibit tent and the hospitality area.
- Potato Expo (January) - Exhibitor.
- Southeast Regional Fruit & Vegetable Conference (January) - Exhibitor.

Marketing Events:
- Syngenta Square / Agronomy Bar (August/September) - A massive outdoor hospitality and educational activation at Farm Progress Show. Superside angle: Designing the digital UI/UX for the 'Agronomy Bar' where growers consult with experts using interactive screens.

Client/Customer Events:
- Field Demo Days & VIP Grower Events (Summer/Fall) - Regional tours. Superside angle: Branded AR filter experiences for VIP growers to view product efficacy in the field.

Internal Events:
- Syngenta Customer Experience Program / Corporate Training - Internal product training sessions. Superside angle: Immersive VR training modules for sales reps to learn about new crop protection chemistry.

Cadence/Seasonality:
- The event calendar is heavily anchored in two distinct seasons: the Q1 indoor winter conference circuit (January–March: Commodity Classic, NFMS, Potato Expo) and the late Q3 outdoor field show season (August–September: Farm Progress Show, Husker Harvest Days).
research.eventBudgetEstimate: $2M+ annually for US trade shows. Exhibitor Magazine reported that Syngenta's budget just for the Farm Progress Show and National Farm Machinery Show combined was between $750,000 and $999,000. Factoring in their massive footprint at Commodity Classic and other Q1/Q3 shows, the total annual spend easily exceeds $2 million.
research.boothFootprint: Massive scale. Indoor shows like Commodity Classic feature premium island booths (50x50 or larger). Outdoor events like the Farm Progress Show utilize multi-acre footprints requiring over 25 semi-truck loads of tents, featuring dedicated 'Syngenta Square' hospitality zones and custom 'Agronomy Bars'.
research.experientialActivations: Syngenta utilizes a 'Genius Bar' concept called the Agronomy Bar where growers get 1-on-1 consultations. They have used physical passports/maps that attendees must complete by visiting different product stations to earn drink tickets for the Syngenta Square beer tent. They also use life-size character masks, virtual field tours inside the booth, and 'Worst Weed Map' interactive pin activations.

research.companyOverview: Volvo Construction Equipment (Volvo CE), a subsidiary of the Volvo Group, is a leading global manufacturer of construction machinery, including excavators, wheel loaders, and articulated haulers. The company is actively driving an industry-wide transition toward electromobility, connected digital services, and autonomous machine technology, which are central themes in their global marketing and event strategies.
research.eventAgendaSummary:
Trade Shows:
- CONEXPO-CON/AGG (Mar 2026, Las Vegas): Exhibitor. Superside angle: Supply immersive digital twin simulators for heavy machinery to reduce physical shipping needs.
- bauma CHINA (Nov 2026, Shanghai): Exhibitor. Superside angle: Design localized AR product visualizers for the Asian market.
- bauma (Apr 2025, Munich): Exhibitor. Superside angle: Create 3D anamorphic LED content highlighting electromobility features.
- ACT Expo (Apr 2025, Anaheim): Exhibitor. Superside angle: Supply interactive touchscreen displays demonstrating electric charging ecosystems.

Marketing Events:
- 'Power Your Ambition' Live Activations (Mar 2026): Host. Superside angle: Gamify influencer machine challenges into an interactive mobile app for attendees.

Client/Customer Events:
- Expo San Juan Minera (May 2026, Argentina): Exhibitor (via dealer EPSA). Superside angle: Build a portable VR walkthrough toolkit for regional dealers.

Internal Events:
- Volvo CE Masters (Global/Regional 2025-2026): Host. Superside angle: Develop competitive mixed-reality training modules for the aftersales technician skills competition.

Cadence/Seasonality:
- Flagship heavy machinery trade shows follow multi-year cycles (CONEXPO every 3 years in March, bauma every 3 years in April). Spring is a peak window for major EV exhibitions. Event planning kicks off 12-18 months in advance for mega-shows.
research.eventBudgetEstimate: High (Multi-million dollar) - Evidenced by their massive 55,000 sq ft footprint at CONEXPO 2026, multi-level architectural builds at global shows like bauma, and routine sponsorship of global influencers and massive operating pits within trade show halls.
research.boothFootprint: 55,000 sq ft at CONEXPO 2026 (Festival Grounds F24029); multi-level custom structures with heavy equipment flooring tiles at bauma 2025.
research.experientialActivations: Live operating pits in the booth for physical test drives, interactive 'SelfieDrive' digital photo booths inside real cabs, connected site-office replicas, and live head-to-head influencer equipment challenges (e.g., featuring YouTube stars and Gold Rush cast members).
research.creativeTechnologyUsage: Interactive digital tables for ecosystem visualization, integrated 3D machine control simulators (Dig Assist), VR/AR photo experiences, live-streamed content displays, and interactive service dashboards.

agencyPartnerAnalysis.role: Booth concept design, architecture, and build
agencyPartnerAnalysis.scope: Exhibitions & Tradeshows (EMEA)
agencyPartnerAnalysis.experientialRelevance: Uniplan designs their massive European physical footprints (e.g., bauma 2025). Superside could partner to layer interactive digital content, 3D animations, or AR layers atop Uniplan's physical structures.
agencyPartnerAnalysis.evidence: Uniplan portfolio case study 'Our Journey Towards Efficient Construction – Volvo CE at bauma' details the structural build and logistics for the 100% electric machine display.

agencyPartnerAnalysis.name: HiQ
agencyPartnerAnalysis.scope: Interactive installations and event technology
agencyPartnerAnalysis.experientialRelevance: HiQ built the 'SelfieDrive' interactive cab experience. This direct overlap indicates Volvo CE actively buys gamified digital installations—a prime service line for Superside.
agencyPartnerAnalysis.evidence: HiQ portfolio case study 'The SelfieDrive Experience' explains the development of an interactive digital action-video photo booth inside a real Volvo cab for exhibitions.

research.opportunityHypothesis: Volvo CE is rapidly transitioning toward electromobility and digital connected services, requiring complex, intangible concepts to be visualized at major trade shows. While they invest in massive physical spaces with live operating pits, the logistical burden of shipping massive equipment is immense. Superside can expand this account by designing high-fidelity 3D digital twins, XR operator simulators, and gamified interactive touchscreens that effectively communicate digital workflows and electric infrastructure without requiring physical transport of every model.
research.successPotentialRationale: Volvo CE represents a 9/10 opportunity due to massive event budgets, a proven history of purchasing custom digital installations (like the SelfieDrive), and a strategic corporate shift towards digital services. They rely heavily on large-scale experiential storytelling at global mega-shows, creating high ongoing demand for immersive creative technology.

research.companyOverview: Ecolab Digital (a division of Ecolab) focuses on AI-powered water intelligence, digital hygiene tracking, and advanced data insights (via platforms like ECOLAB3D and Water Navigator IQ) to optimize resource management across manufacturing, high-tech, data centers, and foodservice industries.
research.eventAgendaSummary:
Trade Shows:
- National Restaurant Association (NRA) Show (Spring, Chicago): Exhibitor. Superside idea: Develop 3D interactive modules or AR content demonstrating back-of-house AI efficiencies for the Ecolab Café experience.
- Datacloud Global Congress (Spring, Cannes, France): Exhibitor. Superside idea: Create dynamic 3D motion graphics of fluid and thermal dynamics to visualize direct-to-chip cooling solutions on large booth LED screens.
- ISSA Show North America (Fall, Booth 1447): Exhibitor. Superside idea: Design touch-screen presentations for the 'Innovation Showcase' that visually break down AI-driven hygiene tracking.
- Hannover Messe (Spring, Germany): Co-Exhibitor with Microsoft. Superside idea: Build an immersive XR experience that lets attendees virtually walk through a water treatment facility powered by ECOLAB3D.

Marketing Events:
- TechWeek Singapore (Fall): Sponsor/Exhibitor. Superside idea: Produce high-fidelity launch videos and digital teaser content for data center cooling tech unveilings.

Client/Customer Events:
- Ecolab Life Sciences Roundtable (Ongoing/Regional): Host. Superside idea: Provide polished presentation decks and interactive digital factory twins for 'Pharma 4.0' compliance demos.
- Digital for Net ZERO Virtual Summit (Recurring): Co-host with Microsoft. Superside idea: Provide virtual event branding, lower-thirds, and broadcast-quality motion graphics.

Internal Events:
- Ecolab Investor Day (Recurring): Host. Superside idea: Design the on-screen UI and continuous looping 3D video environments for walk-through simulations of AI Data Centers and Pest Intelligence zones.

Cadence/Seasonality:
- Heavy spring (April/May) trade show cadence (NRA, Datacloud, Hannover Messe, CheeseExpo) followed by major fall industrial shows (ISSA, TechWeek). Planning for massive experiential builds likely kicks off 6-9 months prior in late summer/early fall.
research.eventBudgetEstimate: Estimated $2M-$5M+ annually for North American and global experiential trade shows. Evidence includes commissioning a massive 30x110 ft (3,300 sq. ft.) booth at the 2024 NRA Show with custom Aluvision architecture and LTE sensor tech, plus heavy investment in four distinct immersive environments for Investor Day 2025 using large-scale LED media.
research.boothFootprint: 3,300 sq. ft. (30x110 feet) documented at the NRA Show. Frequent use of large custom island booths and walk-through immersive spaces.
research.experientialActivations: Built a guided digital journey 'Ecolab Café' simulating front and back-of-house environments. Transformed abstract innovations into four physical environments for Investor Day 2025, including an AI Data Center simulation, a Pest Intelligence big-box retail zone, and a cleanroom with scripted role-play scenarios.
research.creativeTechnologyUsage: Extensive use of large-scale LED media, dynamic environmental lighting, LTE sensors and badge scanners for attendee behavioral tracking, and interactive touchscreen controllers. Heavily utilizes immersive set design paired with digital content to visualize invisible industrial processes like AI fluid cooling and biologics manufacturing.

agencyPartnerAnalysis.name: Storylink Creative
agencyPartnerAnalysis.scope: Trade show design, immersive installations, and event technology integration.
agencyPartnerAnalysis.experientialRelevance: High relevance. Storylink designs Ecolab's massive flagship booths and won the 'Best Use of Technology' award from Exhibitor Magazine for integrating LTE sensors and digital journeys into Ecolab's 3,300 sq ft booth. Superside could partner with them for digital content.
agencyPartnerAnalysis.evidence: Case studies confirm Storylink designed and fabricated the 30x110 booth at NRA 2024 and the four immersive tech environments for Ecolab Investor Day 2025.

agencyPartnerAnalysis.name: NPARALLEL + Atomic Props
agencyPartnerAnalysis.scope: Custom fabrication, booth builds, and oversized interactive props.
agencyPartnerAnalysis.experientialRelevance: High relevance. They physically build Ecolab's environments. Superside could provide the interactive UI/UX or digital screen content that lives inside NPARALLEL's physical fabrications.
agencyPartnerAnalysis.evidence: NPARALLEL portfolio cites fabricating the Ecolab booth for the IPPE Conference 2024 and building a 'larger-than-life' custom trade show prop for Ecolab.

agencyPartnerAnalysis.name: 10x10 Studiolab
agencyPartnerAnalysis.scope: European event activations, booth experience, and brand presence.
agencyPartnerAnalysis.experientialRelevance: Medium relevance. They manage Ecolab's event atmosphere in Europe, meaning they likely oversee digital content localization and booth asset creation for shows like Datacloud Congress.
agencyPartnerAnalysis.evidence: Commissioned event coverage and highlight videos for Ecolab's booth at Datacloud Global Congress in Cannes 2025.

agencyPartnerAnalysis.name: Flat Bold Studio
agencyPartnerAnalysis.scope: Event cinematography, photography, and social content.
agencyPartnerAnalysis.experientialRelevance: Low relevance to 3D/immersive, but proves Ecolab invests in high-end visual documentation of their physical booths.
agencyPartnerAnalysis.evidence: Filmed and edited the event highlight recap for Ecolab at Datacloud Cannes 2025 via 10x10 Studiolab.

research.opportunityHypothesis: Ecolab Digital faces the challenge of making highly technical, invisible solutions (AI water management, ECOLAB3D, digital pest control, data center cooling) tangible for enterprise buyers and investors. Their recent pivot toward award-winning immersive environments requires massive amounts of 3D motion design, dynamic LED content, and interactive UI. Superside can act as a high-volume, high-fidelity creative tech engine for Ecolab's marketing teams and their physical agencies (Storylink, NPARALLEL) to scale these digital storytelling experiences across their global trade show footprint.
research.successPotentialRationale: Ecolab is a 9/10 fit because they have demonstrated high-budget experiential maturity (30x110 booths), a strategic commitment to tech-forward storytelling (winning ExhibitorOnline tech awards), and complex digital products (ECOLAB3D, Water Navigator IQ) that inherently require 3D visualization, motion graphics, and interactive support to sell.

research.companyOverview: Amcor plc is a global leader in developing and producing responsible packaging for food, beverage, pharmaceutical, medical, and personal care products. Headquartered in Switzerland with global operations, the company generates over $23 billion in annualized sales and employs more than 75,000 colleagues across 40 countries, driving packaging innovation, sustainability, and circular economy initiatives.
research.eventAgendaSummary:
Trade Shows:
- PACK EXPO Las Vegas (Sept 29 - Oct 1, 2025, Las Vegas, NV): Exhibitor (Booth N-9210). Superside could provide 3D interactive product teardowns of their AmPrima film layers to replace basic touchscreens.
- IPPE 2025 (Jan 28-30, 2025, Atlanta, GA): Exhibitor (Booth C34139). Superside could produce high-impact LED video content for their Moda machinery demonstrations.
- Cosmoprof Worldwide (Mar 26-28, 2026, Bologna, Italy): Exhibitor (Stand E27). Superside could build a premium AR beauty packaging visualization for the Magic One airless dispenser.
- Interpack (May 2026, Dusseldorf, Germany): Exhibitor. Superside could design an immersive LED environment to visually unify their Flexibles and Rigids divisions.
- Cosmetic Business Munich (June 10-11, 2026, Munich, Germany): Exhibitor (Stand D12). Superside could develop an interactive sustainability impact calculator app.
- CPHI Milan (Oct 6-8, 2026, Milan, Italy): Exhibitor. Superside could create virtual tours of their healthcare packaging cleanrooms.

Marketing Events:
- Amcor Lift-Off Challenge (Winter 2025/2026): Sponsor/Host. Superside could design an immersive digital campaign and interactive landing page to attract startup packaging innovations.
- PACK EXPO Pre-Show Promotion (Ongoing): Attendee acquisition. Superside could supply high-velocity, engaging pre-show teaser videos and interactive social media assets starting four months pre-event.

Client/Customer Events:
- Simultaneous Innovation Day with Reckitt (May 2025): Host. Superside could build a bespoke virtual event platform linking physical mock-ups to digital data across multi-country hubs.
- Protein PACT Solutions Summit (Oct 7-9, 2026, New Orleans, LA): Sponsor. Superside could provide animated digital presentations for their summit speaking slots.

Internal Events:
- unknown (LinkedIn was checked via dorking but no usable event evidence was found; focus is heavily on external trade shows).

Cadence/Seasonality:
- Amcor maintains a rigorous global trade show schedule with a heavy concentration in Autumn (PACK EXPO, CPHI, Global Produce Show) and Spring (Interpack, Cosmoprof). Planning cycles for flagship shows begin at least 4-6 months in advance, featuring extensive pre-show digital marketing.
research.eventBudgetEstimate: Multi-million dollar annual budget. Amcor executes large-scale, 6-7 day multi-division custom booth builds for flagship shows like PACK EXPO and Interpack, employs dedicated Sr. Experiential Marketing Managers, and invests heavily in interactive digital tools, live equipment shipping, and global hybrid customer innovation days.
research.boothFootprint: Massive island and peninsula footprints. Evidence points to vast consolidated booths (e.g., Booth N-9210 at PACK EXPO Las Vegas) that bring together Amcor Flexibles, Amcor Rigid Packaging, and specialty cartons into a single, highly integrated experiential environment.
research.experientialActivations: Amcor creates highly interactive environments featuring live, on-site equipment demonstrations (e.g., Moda machinery and HMPS Propac VFFS), and interactive LCA (Life Cycle Assessment) digital applications allowing attendees to compare 130+ sustainable packaging options. They also host 'simultaneous innovation days' featuring physical prototype mock-ups tied to real-time hybrid digital feedback loops.
research.creativeTechnologyUsage: The company deploys interactive digital touchscreens to visualize their ASSET life cycle assessment data. They natively integrate AI vision technology and advanced analytics visualization (via AVEVA) into their live machinery displays to map real-time performance and environmental impact.

agencyPartnerAnalysis.scope: Live machinery demonstration
agencyPartnerAnalysis.experientialRelevance: HMPS Propac engineers the Liquiflex VFFS pouch systems that Amcor runs live in their trade show booths, representing an opportunity for Superside to create overlay digital content explaining the machine's operation.
agencyPartnerAnalysis.evidence: Cited in a 2025 Pack Expo press release detailing that Amcor's equipment demonstrations will include the Liquiflex VFFS engineered by Australian OEM HMPS Propac.

agencyPartnerAnalysis.scope: Trade show co-demonstration
agencyPartnerAnalysis.experientialRelevance: They co-exhibit with Amcor, demonstrating integrated systems, meaning Superside could design unified booth graphics or interactive demos that seamlessly connect both brands' technologies.
agencyPartnerAnalysis.evidence: Announced as joining the Amcor booth at IPPE 2025 to demonstrate their machinery with the Moda system.

agencyPartnerAnalysis.name: RoundBox Creative
agencyPartnerAnalysis.scope: Exhibition stand branding and CNC production artwork
agencyPartnerAnalysis.experientialRelevance: This agency handles technical layouts and print files for Amcor's exhibition stands; Superside could partner or compete by offering higher-end 3D visual design or digital content integration into these physical structures.
agencyPartnerAnalysis.evidence: RoundBox Creative's portfolio lists Amcor as a client for original design, bespoke graphic layouts, and CNC cutting files for exhibition stands.

agencyPartnerAnalysis.name: Pace Agency
agencyPartnerAnalysis.scope: Branding, event graphics, signage
agencyPartnerAnalysis.experientialRelevance: Provides traditional 2D event graphics. Superside can elevate this by offering interactive, animated, or AR-enhanced event graphic capabilities.
agencyPartnerAnalysis.evidence: Pace Agency published a case study highlighting their work for Amcor across branding, photography, event graphics, and signage.

research.opportunityHypothesis: Amcor treats trade shows as high-value experiential marketing, employing dedicated internal experiential marketing leaders and running rigorous 4-month omni-channel promotion campaigns ahead of major expos. Since they already rely on massive island footprints and custom interactive digital applications (like their 130-product ASSET comparison tool), Superside is perfectly positioned to modernize their interactive offerings. Pitching high-end 3D product teardowns, AR engagements for their live machinery demos, and scalable video production for their extensive pre-show campaigns directly aligns with their mature event strategy.
research.successPotentialRationale: Amcor receives an 8 out of 10 because they possess massive event budgets, clear internal experiential leadership, and a proven appetite for incorporating digital interactive tools into their physical booths. Their focus on sustainability metrics creates a perfect use case for Superside's immersive data visualization and creative tech solutions.

research.companyOverview: AutoNation, Inc. is America's largest automotive retailer, operating hundreds of new vehicle franchises across the United States. Beyond traditional automotive sales, the company has aggressively expanded its digital footprint through AutoNation.com, service centers, and proprietary financial products. AutoNation is a massive player in high-visibility experiential marketing and sponsorships, actively investing millions into motorsports (Formula 1, INDYCAR) and driving a nationwide philanthropic field movement through its flagship 'DRV PNK' breast cancer awareness initiative.
research.eventAgendaSummary:
Trade Shows:
- NADA Show (National Automobile Dealers Association) | Winter (Jan/Feb) | Las Vegas, NV / New Orleans, LA | Attendee/Sponsor | Superside could design interactive, data-driven VIP meeting environments or VR dealership tours for their B2B networking and recruitment lounges.

Marketing Events:
- Formula 1 Miami Grand Prix | May | Miami, FL | Sponsor/Exhibitor (AutoNation Grandstand, AutoNation Chill Zone, Pit Stop) | Superside could deliver custom AR engagements or interactive digital photo moments within the AutoNation Chill Zone to engage racing fans.
- INDYCAR Series & Indy 500 | May | Indianapolis, IN & Various | Co-Sponsor (Meyer Shank Racing) | Superside could produce dynamic 3D content or digital leaderboards for their on-site fan activation footprints.

Client/Customer Events:
- DRV PNK Campaign Activations & Tour | Year-Round (Peaks in October) | Nationwide | Organizer | Superside could modernize the DRV PNK mobile photo booth with AI-generated customizable digital postcards that fans can instantly share.
- AutoNation Charity Golf Tournaments (e.g., Hope On the Green) | Q3/Q4 | MD/FL | Organizer | Superside could provide bespoke hole-activation digital overlays and premium branded environmental signage.

Internal Events:
- AutoNation Associate Recognition ('Go Be Great') | Year-Round | Nationwide | Organizer | Superside could create immersive storytelling content highlighting top-performing associates for internal rallies and galas.

Cadence/Seasonality:
- The event rhythm kicks off with B2B automotive focus at NADA in late Jan/early Feb, transitions into massive consumer sports sponsorships in May (INDYCAR, F1 Miami), and shifts into high gear for regional charity golf tournaments and DRV PNK consumer activations in Q3 and October.
research.eventBudgetEstimate: Multi-million dollar estimated event and sponsorship budget, evidenced by their title sponsorships of INDYCAR teams (Meyer Shank Racing), massive branded infrastructure at the F1 Miami Grand Prix (AutoNation Grandstand, Chill Zone), and funding of nationwide DRV PNK experiential tours.
research.boothFootprint: Unknown for traditional indoor exhibition islands; however, they utilize massive outdoor activation footprints, including the dedicated 'AutoNation Chill Zone', 'AutoNation Pit Stop', and the 'AutoNation DRV PNK Patio' at major stadiums and tracks.
research.experientialActivations: AutoNation executes widespread physical activations, particularly at motorsports events where they build out 'Chill Zones' and 'Pit Stops' for fan engagement. For their charitable arm, they converted a vintage Shasta trailer into a mobile photo booth for the DRV PNK Across America tour, and they host large-scale charity golf activations featuring designated vendor activation spaces and vehicle display areas.
research.creativeTechnologyUsage: Currently utilizing digital photo booths and interactive messaging stations ('Give Love Letters') for their charitable events. They have heavy digital customer journey mapping integrations via Epsilon, but visible evidence of advanced XR, 3D, or AR in their physical activations is limited, representing a clear white space for creative tech integration.

agencyPartnerAnalysis.name: Zimmerman Advertising
agencyPartnerAnalysis.scope: Integrated campaigns, omni-channel media, and lead creative for the 'Go Be Great' and 'DRV PNK' campaigns.
agencyPartnerAnalysis.experientialRelevance: Zimmerman drives the creative behind the massive DRV PNK movement which translates into heavy field marketing. Superside can pitch to Zimmerman as an agile digital production partner for event-specific interactive assets.
agencyPartnerAnalysis.evidence: Industry PR and Winmo profiles confirm Zimmerman's long-standing relationship as the architect of the DRV PNK initiative and national ad campaigns.

agencyPartnerAnalysis.name: Rednoir
agencyPartnerAnalysis.scope: Immersive brand activations, custom fabrication, and event environments.
agencyPartnerAnalysis.experientialRelevance: Rednoir physically builds AutoNation's immersive activations in South Florida (likely tied to F1 Miami and local events). Superside could partner with Rednoir to provide the digital content (motion graphics, 3D, XR) that runs on the hardware they fabricate.
agencyPartnerAnalysis.evidence: Rednoir's official portfolio explicitly lists AutoNation as a client for 'Brand Activations Miami | Immersive Custom Design'.

agencyPartnerAnalysis.name: I Think Studios
agencyPartnerAnalysis.scope: Video and campaign production.
agencyPartnerAnalysis.experientialRelevance: Collaborated on the 'Go Be Great' campaign; Superside could complement them by handling live-event video graphics or interactive experiential content.
agencyPartnerAnalysis.evidence: AutoNation's 2022 press release names I Think Studios as a co-creator of their national employee-centric campaign.

agencyPartnerAnalysis.name: Epsilon
agencyPartnerAnalysis.scope: CRM, loyalty programs, and targeted marketing data warehousing.
agencyPartnerAnalysis.experientialRelevance: They ensure digital continuity from physical event data capture to personalized follow-up. Superside could design lead-capture front-ends that tie into Epsilon's backend.
agencyPartnerAnalysis.evidence: AutoNation's VP of Customer Marketing confirmed in an ANA interview that Epsilon manages their customer data warehouse.

research.opportunityHypothesis: AutoNation invests aggressively in high-visibility sports sponsorships (F1, INDYCAR) and regional charity events (DRV PNK) but currently relies mostly on physical fabrication and traditional engagements like photo booths. Superside can penetrate this account by pitching modern, interactive digital overlays (XR, gamified lead capture, 3D fan experiences) that elevate these massive physical footprints into data-capturing, immersive brand moments.
research.successPotentialRationale: AutoNation is an 8/10 fit because they possess a massive, proven experiential budget (F1, INDYCAR, nationwide tours) and an established experiential fabrication partner (Rednoir), but lack visible high-end digital/XR experiential executions. Superside's digital creative tech offerings perfectly fill this gap without competing against their physical fabricators.

research.companyOverview: Booking.com, a subsidiary of Booking Holdings Inc., is one of the world's leading digital travel companies. The in-house Booking.com Brand Studio spearheads major global creative campaigns, which frequently translate into highly visible, immersive B2C brand activations (such as custom pop-up accommodations) and massive B2B partner conferences designed to secure the brand's position as the top choice for hoteliers and travel operators.
research.eventAgendaSummary:
Trade Shows:
- ITB Berlin (March, Berlin): Exhibitor/Key Sponsor. Heavily visible as a primary market distribution channel. Superside could provide 3D anamorphic video content for overhead LED screens to capture attention in crowded European travel halls.
- WTM London (November, London): Exhibitor. Superside could develop interactive touch-screen booking pathway demos and ROI calculators for their B2B hospitality audience.

Marketing Events:
- Consumer PR Pop-Ups (Ongoing/Summer/Holidays): Brand Activator (e.g., 'Cosmic Cabin', 'Snow Globe', 'Ice Cream Truck' stays). Superside could build custom AR filters and digital gamification that extend the lifespan and social reach of these highly localized physical pop-ups.
- Pride / #TravelProud Activations (February/March): Sponsor/Activator. Superside could provide digital UI/UX design and motion graphics for interactive video booths (similar to the giant glowing suitcase activation at Sydney World Pride).

Client/Customer Events:
- Click. EMEA (May, Amsterdam): Host/Organizer. A flagship partner summit. Superside could support their agency GPJ with high-fidelity 3D motion graphics for the mainstage keynotes or interactive wayfinding apps.
- Click. APAC (September, Bali): Host/Organizer. Superside could develop regionalized, localized digital signage and immersive projection mappings for evening networking events.
- Click. Americas (May, Miami - based on 2024/2025 cadence): Host. Superside could design digital brand integration content for their sports-themed live activations (e.g., WNBA/NBA partnerships).

Internal Events:
- Experimentation Conference (May, Amsterdam HQ): Host. An invite-only technical event for data scientists and experimenters. Superside could design polished data-visualization presentations and internal event branding.

Cadence/Seasonality:
- The B2B event rhythm is heavily weighted toward Spring (ITB in March, Click. EMEA/Americas in May) and Fall (Click. APAC in September, WTM London in November). Consumer PR activations are continuous but spike around major cultural moments (Super Bowl, Pride, Summer travel season, Holiday season).
research.eventBudgetEstimate: Unknown exact figure, but evidence points to a multi-million dollar annual budget. This is supported by their retention of global tier-1 agencies (George P. Johnson, HAVAS Red), hosting proprietary global summits (Click.) across multiple continents at premium venues, executing elaborate custom fabrications (100-ton sandcastles, custom ice cream trucks), and historically winning 'Best Exhibitor' at massive global trade shows like ITB Berlin.
research.boothFootprint: Unknown exact dimensions, but historical ITB Berlin presence included multi-story custom builds that won the 'Best Exhibitor Award'. Their experiential footprint frequently relies on massive custom architectural builds (e.g., 8x18 ft sandcastles, giant suitcases) and immersive projection rooms rather than standard modular booths.
research.experientialActivations: Highly creative B2C PR pop-ups turning unusual structures into bookable stays (e.g., a 100-ton Sandcastle at Coney Island, an Ice Cream Truck in NYC, a Cosmic Cabin, and an Australian beach Snow Globe). Supported Sydney World Pride with a giant custom-built glowing suitcase functioning as a community video booth. At B2B events, they use immersive projection spaces (the 'Make a Splash' room) and live sports tie-ins (a live WNBA basketball court at Click Miami).
research.creativeTechnologyUsage: Interactive video booths (PLAY Platform at Pride), immersive multi-wall projections (rooms that change environments from pools to roller coasters via audience input), dynamic LED screens embedded in custom fabrications, interactive gamification (Kick Challenge), and data visualization displays.

agencyPartnerAnalysis.name: George P. Johnson (GPJ)

research.companyOverview: Cargill is a global food, agricultural, financial, and industrial conglomerate, and one of the largest privately held corporations in the world. Operating across various sectors including food ingredients, beauty, polymer additives, and animal nutrition, the company relies heavily on trade shows, B2B marketing events, and experiential innovation centers to connect with buyers and demonstrate formulation, sustainability, and technological advancements.
research.eventAgendaSummary:
Trade Shows:
- IFT FIRST (July, Chicago, IL): Exhibitor and sponsor featuring interactive 'solution stations' for food formulation. Idea: AR-guided flavor formulation app for attendees.
- SupplySide West (October, Las Vegas, NV): Exhibitor featuring gamified concepts and guest speakers. Idea: Interactive digital screens for 'Ingredient Idol' voting.
- IPPE (Winter, Atlanta, GA): Exhibitor launching new corporate branding via a major ET GLOBAL partnership. Idea: 3D anamorphic displays to draw traffic to the newly branded booth.
- K Show (October, Dusseldorf, Germany): Exhibitor with a two-story custom booth. Idea: Immersive LED ceiling installations demonstrating polymer additive benefits.
- in-cosmetics Global (November, Bangkok, Thailand): Exhibitor in formulation lab sessions. Idea: Touchscreen interactive displays for beauty formulation labs.

Marketing Events:
- House of Chocolate (Europe): Standalone immersive marketing activation designed to educate B2B chocolate buyers. Idea: VR farm-to-factory storytelling experience.

Client/Customer Events:
- Cargill Innovation Centers (Singapore, Minneapolis, Elk River): Ongoing customer prototyping tours and lab visits. Idea: Motion graphics and digital twin content demonstrating global supply chains.

Internal Events:
- unknown (No public details available regarding specific internal summits or sales kickoffs).

Cadence/Seasonality:
- Year-round global presence with a heavy concentration in North American food ingredient shows during Summer (IFT) and Fall (SupplySide West), while industrial and European shows peak in Q4 (K Show, EuroTier) and Q1 (IPPE, Plastex).
research.eventBudgetEstimate: Estimated at $18M - $22M+ globally. Market analyses cite Cargill's trade show spend near $18M-$22M. This aligns with physical evidence of massive global programs, including permanent 10,000 sq. ft. experiential Innovation Centers, custom two-story builds at international industrial shows (K Show), and high-frequency 40x50+ booths at premier food & beverage shows utilizing multiple premium global exhibit agencies.
research.boothFootprint: Evidence of massive modular and custom footprints, including a two-story trade show booth at K Show with five product kiosks, a 20x30 to 40x50 modular exhibit system at IFT by nParallel, and a 10,000 sq. ft. permanent experiential laboratory (Cargill Innovation Center).
research.experientialActivations: Created the 'House of Chocolate' as a standalone immersive marketing gateway to educate B2B chocolate connoisseurs. Developed experiential lab-based facilities (Cargill Innovation Centers) combining spatial design, interactive touchpoints, and motion graphics. Features gamified 'Solution Stations' at IFT with passport-style tasting journeys.
research.creativeTechnologyUsage: Utilizes interactive video installations, a 25-foot interactive video wall at their Elk River Innovation Center, gamified digital engagements (Ingredient Idol voting, interactive solution stations), 3D product visualizations for product kiosks, and extensive motion graphics layered into physical lab environments.

research.companyOverview: Constellation Energy is America's largest producer of clean, carbon-free energy and a leading nuclear energy operator, possessing roughly 55 gigawatts of capacity. Following its separation from Exelon, Constellation has positioned itself at the forefront of the energy transition, heavily targeting the AI and data center boom by striking long-term clean power agreements with major tech hyperscalers and restarting major nuclear sites like the Crane Clean Energy Center.
research.eventAgendaSummary:
Trade Shows:
- CERAWeek (March, Houston): Major Sponsor/Speaker. Superside Idea: High-end 3D animated executive presentation design to visualize AI data center power demand during CEO keynotes.
- NECX Nuclear Energy Conference & Expo (Annually): Exhibitor at Booth 409. Superside Idea: Interactive touchscreen wall displaying the nationwide clean output of their nuclear fleet.
- Datacloud USA (Annually): Gold Sponsor. Superside Idea: AR-powered booth demo showcasing 100% clean energy data center integrations for hyperscalers.
- Metro Connect Fall (Fall season): Exhibitor. Superside Idea: Digital content loop explaining how clean power reaches fiber/metro ecosystems.
- NYACS Trade Show (May): Exhibitor at Booth 1101. Superside Idea: VR walkthrough of a turnkey EV charging station installation.

Marketing Events:
- Constellation FURYK & FRIENDS PGA Tour Champions Event (October, FL): Title Sponsor. Superside Idea: Interactive fan zone kiosks featuring kinetic energy challenges or AR golf swings tied to clean energy metrics.
- Pro Football Hall of Fame Village (Ongoing, OH): Technology showcase partner. Superside Idea: Immersive projection mapping in their 75,000-sq-ft facility to engage sports fans with sustainability themes.

Client/Customer Events:
- Constellation Fishing for a Cure (April, Braidwood Station IL): Host/Sponsor for partner charity tournament. Superside Idea: Custom branded environmental signage and digital experiential photo-ops.
- Mid-C Seminar (Annually): Attendee/Sponsor. Superside Idea: Premium digital playbooks and interactive collateral for executive networking.

Internal Events:
- Constellation ERG Chapter Summit (Annually): Host for 161+ board members. Superside Idea: Internal event branding kits and presentation design to standardize high-quality employee experiences.

Cadence/Seasonality:
- Q1 is anchored by massive executive thought-leadership at CERAWeek. Q2 features regional trade shows and specialized expos (NYACS). Q3/Q4 shifts toward digital infrastructure shows (Datacloud, Metro Connect) and their flagship consumer marketing event, the October PGA tournament.
research.eventBudgetEstimate: $10M–$20M+ annually. Constellation pays top-tier sponsorship fees for global events like CERAWeek, donates $500,000 yearly strictly as a charity baseline for the Furyk & Friends PGA event (excluding Title Sponsorship and Fan Zone activation costs), and maintains a high volume of regional B2B trade show booths across the country.
research.boothFootprint: Constellation takes standard 10x10 and 10x20 inline booths at regional/industry events (e.g., Booth 409 at NECX, Booth 1101 at NYACS), but scales up to massive, multi-zone custom pavilion footprints ('Fan Zones') for their consumer sports sponsorships and mega-events.
research.experientialActivations: Constellation invests heavily in physical experiential spaces. They produced a massive 'Fan Zone' at the 101st PGA Championship to reflect their official energy partner status. At the Pro Football Hall of Fame Village, they power a 75,000-square-foot mixed-use facility that showcases their sustainability solutions. They also recently funded the 'ReGen Lab' at UIUC, an experiential learning hub for the clean-energy sector.
research.creativeTechnologyUsage: Strong adoption of immersive tech for educational and promotional use. They are using Virtual Reality (VR) simulations at the UIUC ReGen Lab to let users explore smart grids and hydrogen systems. They also leverage advanced video content and digital platforms to visualize clean energy offset tracking at their PGA events.

research.opportunityHypothesis: Constellation is rapidly expanding its footprint due to the AI data center boom and the massive demand for clean nuclear baseload power. As they enter aggressive growth mode, their executive presence at B2B shows like CERAWeek, Datacloud, and RE+ is more critical than ever to secure hyperscaler contracts. Superside can elevate their B2B trade show booths with the same level of immersive digital storytelling (AR, VR, interactive data walls) they currently fund for their B2C/CSR initiatives (like the ReGen VR Lab and PGA Fan Zones), unifying their brand as a futuristic tech-enabler.
research.successPotentialRationale: Constellation scores an 8 out of 10 based on their massive budgets, documented track record of funding VR/experiential activations, and a highly urgent B2B narrative around powering AI data centers. The only minor friction is their existing roster of established agencies for consumer sports, making their B2B Trade Show and Executive Presentation teams the most viable entry point.

research.companyOverview: HubSpot, Inc. is a leading provider of cloud-based customer relationship management (CRM), marketing, sales, and customer service software. - SaaStr Annual (May, San Francisco, CA) - Sponsor/Attendee: Major presence targeting SaaS founders. *Superside angle: High-impact booth motion graphics and interactive CRM demo screens.*
- SaaStr AI (Dec, London, UK) - Sponsor/Attendee: European SaaS presence. *Superside angle: AI-themed digital content walls.*

- GROW Europe (Spring, London/Sydney) - Host: Regional customer summit. *Superside angle: Localized digital presentation design and experiential branding to match the global flagship aesthetics.*

At SXSW, they host the Founders Oasis networking activation supported by massive out-of-home experiential marketing, including a vinyl wrap covering the Fairmont Hotel.
research.creativeTechnologyUsage: HubSpot aggressively integrated AI at INBOUND 2025 by deploying Voxo to provide real-time AI session summaries across the event. They manage a premier portfolio of master-planned apartment communities, office buildings, resorts, and major retail centers (including Irvine Spectrum Center and Fashion Island). research.eventBudgetEstimate: Unknown exact figures, but estimated in the multi-millions annually based on large-scale bespoke presences at CES, Monterey Car Week, and the New York Auto Show, alongside a pan-European mobile pop-up tour fleet. The massive recent capital injections from the Saudi PIF and Uber ($1B+) provide substantial marketing leverage.

They also run active mobile experiential tours bringing expandable showroom trailers directly to European target markets.

At CES 2026, they showcased custom halo-mounted LEDs for passenger identification and personalized interactive in-cabin touchscreens inside their Gravity Robotaxi.

research.companyOverview: Nvidia Corporation is a global technology leader and the pioneer of GPU-accelerated computing. Originally known for PC gaming, Nvidia is now the foundational infrastructure provider for the artificial intelligence revolution, building AI factories, enterprise AI software, physical AI/robotics platforms, and digital twin environments (Omniverse) for the world's largest industries.

- SIGGRAPH 2026 (Los Angeles, CA - Jul 2026): Exhibitor/Speaker. Heavy focus on graphics and AI. Superside could develop real-time rendering demos and 3D motion graphic loops for the main booth.

Marketing Events:
- GTC 2026 (San Jose, CA - Mar 2026): Host/Flagship. The 'Woodstock of AI' featuring a massive mainstage keynote and huge multi-zone footprint. Superside could build massive LED motion graphic animations and interstitial video content for keynotes and breakout sessions.
- GTC Taipei at Computex (Taipei, Taiwan - Jun 2026): Host. Regional extension. Superside could offer fast-turn localization and cultural adaptation of main GTC visual assets.
- GTC Paris at VivaTech (Paris, France - Jun 2025): Host/Sponsor. Superside could support regional event marketing with localized digital promotion kits.

research.eventBudgetEstimate: Unknown exact figure, but estimated in the tens of millions of dollars. research.companyOverview: Oyster HR is a global employment platform (Employer of Record) that simplifies hiring, paying, and caring for distributed workforces in over 180 countries. research.companyOverview: PrizePicks is the largest independently owned Daily Fantasy Sports (DFS) operator in North America. PrizePicks is aggressively scaling its real-world presence, moving beyond digital user acquisition to focus on tentpole live events, in-stadium VIP hospitality, programmatic digital out-of-home (DOOH) activations, and hyper-local watch parties to engage sports fans.

research.eventBudgetEstimate: High (7-figure annual event budget). Satair exhibits at nearly every major tier-1 aerospace and MRO trade show globally, utilizing large custom island booths (e.g., Booth 1-326 at MRO Europe). They also fly in global executives for major MoU signings at these events.

research.companyOverview: Syngenta Crop Protection AG, a business unit of the global Syngenta Group headquartered in Switzerland, is a leading provider of agricultural science and technology, specifically focusing on crop protection, seeds, biologicals, and digital agriculture. research.eventBudgetEstimate: Multi-million dollar tier globally (estimated $5M - $10M+). research.companyOverview: Booking.com's Learning & Development (L&D) division is responsible for upskilling, onboarding, and engaging the company's 5,000+ global employees. Operating primarily through its 'B.Learn' enterprise knowledge repository and a human-centered design approach, the L&D team focuses on skills mapping, continuous learning, and fostering corporate culture. They execute large-scale internal events, such as the Booking.com Annual Meeting (BAM) and global DEI summits, while their leaders actively speak at top-tier European HR and Learning technology conferences to share their organizational strategies.
research.eventAgendaSummary:
Trade Shows:
- Learning Technologies (April 2025, London) - Speaker. Superside could design dynamic, AR-enhanced presentation decks for their L&D thought leadership keynotes.
- World of Learning Summit (February 2026, London) - Attendee/Speaker. Superside could create interactive digital takeaways or networking AR filters for their representatives to share.
- Offbeat Sparks (2026, Amsterdam) - Organizer/Speaker. Superside could produce engaging motion-graphic intro loops for the fast-paced 10-minute speaker sessions.

Marketing Events:
- unknown

Client/Customer Events:
- unknown

Internal Events:
- Booking.com Annual Meeting [BAM] (January/February, Amsterdam) - Host. Superside could create an interactive AR scavenger hunt or digital content walls for the networking area to drive cross-department engagement for the 2,000+ attendees.
- DEI Global Summit (Simultaneous in Amsterdam, Manchester, New York, Tokyo) - Host. Superside could build a synchronized, multi-continent digital motion-graphics package or interactive virtual portal to unify the hybrid audience.

Cadence/Seasonality:
- The flagship internal meeting (BAM) traditionally lands in Q1 (January/February). External L&D speaking engagements are highly active in Q1 and Q2 (February-April). Continuous internal knowledge sharing runs year-round via the B.Learn platform.
research.eventBudgetEstimate: High. The Booking.com Annual Meeting (BAM) brings roughly 2,000 global employees to Amsterdam, requiring extensive travel budgets, premium venues like the Beurs van Berlage, and external agency support. Simultaneous multi-continent filming and production for summits further indicate a significant budget allocated to internal event execution.

research.companyOverview: CarGurus is a leading multinational digital automotive marketplace that connects buyers and sellers of new and used vehicles. By leveraging proprietary data analytics, AI, and search algorithms, the company provides transparency in vehicle pricing and dealer reputation to consumers, while offering dealerships highly targeted advertising, digital retailing, and lead-generation tools. The company focuses its B2B marketing efforts on engaging dealership partners through large-scale automotive trade shows, VIP hospitality events, and thought-leadership summits.
research.eventAgendaSummary:
Trade Shows:
- NADA Show (Las Vegas, Feb 2026): Key exhibitor (Booth 1501W) and high-level sponsor. They use this massive automotive event to launch products like AI Dealership Mode and PriceVantage. Superside could design interactive touch-screen or AR installations that visually simulate their AI data flow for dealers on the show floor.
- Digital Dealer Conference & Expo (Las Vegas, Oct): Consistent exhibitor and session speaker (e.g., Booth 629 in 2024). Superside could provide gamified lead-capture experiences and dynamic presentation decks for their on-stage data engineers.

Marketing Events:
- 'Big Deal' National Campaign Activations (Launched Feb 2026): Large-scale consumer and dealer-facing brand rollout featuring influencers and digital video. Superside could build physical pop-up activations or dynamic digital OOH content that bridges the national TV campaign with real-world experiential touchpoints.

Client/Customer Events:
- CarGurus Navigate / VIP Dealer Events: Historically hosted their own proprietary 'Navigate' automotive conference, and actively hires event managers to execute ongoing VIP hospitality dinners for top-tier dealership clients. Superside could provide bespoke digital invitations, branded environment design, and ambient motion graphics for these high-touch regional dinners.

Internal Events:
- Recruiting & Diversity Events (e.g., Women Leaders in Tech): Partner with groups like PowerToFly for engineering networking events. Superside could supply high-end branded collateral, pop-up recruitment backdrops, and interactive employee culture displays.

Cadence/Seasonality:
- The major B2B event push is heavily front-loaded in Q1 to align with the NADA Show (January/February), followed by a steady cadence of regional Digital Dealer events in the fall (October). Major consumer brand campaigns typically launch in early Q1 ahead of the spring auto-buying season.
research.eventBudgetEstimate: High. While specific figures are not public, their premium island booths at massive shows like NADA, high-tier sponsorships, dedicated internal event marketing headcount, and national multimedia brand campaigns indicate a multi-million dollar annual B2B and B2C marketing budget.
research.boothFootprint: Large island booth (e.g., Booth 1501W at NADA 2026 and Booth 629 at Digital Dealer), though exact square footage is unknown.
research.experientialActivations: Primarily focused on live software demonstrations on the trade show floor, VIP hospitality dinners for top-tier dealership clients, and influencer-led consumer campaign activations.
research.creativeTechnologyUsage: Heavy reliance on in-app AI features (Dealership Mode, Discover search, PriceVantage) demonstrated via screens. No verified heavy XR/AR or spatial computing hardware on the show floor yet.

agencyPartnerAnalysis.scope: National brand campaigns, notably the 2025/2026 'Big Deal' TV and digital rollout.
agencyPartnerAnalysis.experientialRelevance: Superside could partner with or supplement Bindery by adapting their broad consumer creative concepts into localized B2B trade show booth graphics and environmental designs.
agencyPartnerAnalysis.evidence: Cited in February 2025/2026 press releases as the creative partner for the 'Big Deal' campaign.

agencyPartnerAnalysis.experientialRelevance: Low direct experiential relevance, but indicates a high volume of digital video needs that Superside could fulfill for their digital event amplification.

agencyPartnerAnalysis.scope: Creator sourcing, content production, and experiential influencer activations.
agencyPartnerAnalysis.experientialRelevance: High. The Goat Agency handles physical experiential activations for creators. Superside could provide physical event design and digital content assets for these influencer meet-and-greets.
agencyPartnerAnalysis.evidence: Featured in agency case studies highlighting CarGurus creator campaigns and experiential activations.

agencyPartnerAnalysis.scope: UK TV advertising campaigns.
agencyPartnerAnalysis.experientialRelevance: Indicates a decentralized regional agency approach. Superside could offer localized European event asset production to ensure brand consistency.

research.opportunityHypothesis: CarGurus relies on proving the efficacy of its AI and analytics tools to dealerships at major B2B trade shows like NADA. Their current presence leans toward traditional software demos and standard booth builds. research.companyOverview: Dun & Bradstreet is a leading global provider of business decisioning data and analytics. The company enables enterprises, financial institutions, and public sector organizations to manage risk, accelerate revenue, and improve business performance. With recent innovations like D&B.AI, the company is heavily focused on delivering predictive insights, supply chain mapping, and ESG intelligence.
research.eventAgendaSummary:
Trade Shows:
- Google Cloud Next (Spring 2026, USA) - Sponsor/Exhibitor (Booth 6602). Superside idea: Experiential AR demo showing D&B data enriching cloud applications in real-time.
- DLA Supply Chain Alliance Symposium & Expo (Spring 2026, USA) - Exhibitor (Booth #502 alongside partner Four Inc.). Superside idea: Interactive supply chain mapping demo that gamifies risk assessment for defense attendees.
- Credit Congress & Expo (Summer 2025, USA) - Exhibitor (#536). Superside idea: An ROI calculator touchscreen kiosk for commercial credit risk solutions.
- HKMA Data Summit (July 2025, Hong Kong) - Exhibitor/Speaker. Superside idea: An interactive digital infographic wall showing live SME credit analytics to attract banking attendees.
- ReThink HK (Fall 2024/2026, Hong Kong) - Sponsor/Exhibitor (Booth F10). Superside idea: Interactive ESG impact slider demo showcasing sustainability insights.

Marketing Events:
- TradeView Live (October 2025, Digital) - Co-host/Speaker with Vizion. Superside idea: High-end virtual production or XR broadcast set for live trade analysis and webinars.
- Regional Brand Activations (Ongoing) - Host. Recent 2026 job postings indicate a mandate for "immersive brand activations." Superside idea: Modular pop-up activations that scale across regional B2B marketing roadshows.

Client/Customer Events:
- Partner Ecosystem VIP Experiences (Ongoing) - Sponsor/Attendee. D&B actively sponsors partner conferences like Salesforce and NetSuite. Superside idea: Custom "Data & AI" VIP lounges with immersive projection mapping for high-value client networking.

Internal Events:
- Corporate / Team Member Moments (Ongoing) - Host. Internal culture events and sales kickoffs are managed by their experiential team. Superside idea: Gamified networking apps and digital interactive installations for internal global sales meetings.

Cadence/Seasonality:
- D&B follows a steady annual rhythm, heavily focused on the Spring (Google Cloud Next, DLA Symposium, Credit Congress) and Fall (ReThink HK, global trade expos) conference seasons, aligned with major technology and financial sector trade shows.
research.eventBudgetEstimate: High (Multi-million dollar global budget). D&B consistently sponsors tier-1 global tech events (Google Cloud Next), specialized finance/defense symposiums, and regional summits. A 2026 hiring push for an "Events & Experiences Manager" to manage "high impact experiential programs" and "budget tracking" confirms robust, dedicated funding for experiential marketing.
research.boothFootprint: Evidence shows varied booth footprints, ranging from standard inline spaces at specialized events (Booth F10 at ReThink HK, Booth #536 at Credit Congress) to premium placements at major partner shows (Booth 6602 at Google Cloud Next). Specific square footage is unknown, but tiering suggests 10x10 to 20x20 island configurations depending on the sponsorship level.
research.experientialActivations: D&B is actively shifting toward higher-end event design. A late 2025/early 2026 job description for an Events & Experiences Manager specifically mandates executing "high impact experiential programs, including immersive brand activations, integrated event marketing, [and] standout customer experiences." Current activations include interactive software demos and co-branded digital broadcasts like TradeView Live.
research.creativeTechnologyUsage: Currently, D&B utilizes interactive software demonstrations for products like D&B.AI, D&B Connect, and supply chain mapping. The explicit corporate mandate to develop "immersive brand activations" signals an emerging appetite for AR/XR, generative AI-driven interactive content, and advanced digital storytelling at their physical booths.

With a busy global trade show calendar and a mandate to elevate customer experiences, Superside can secure this account by pitching high-end creative technology, 3D booth conceptualization, and interactive data visualizations that move D&B beyond standard SaaS booth demos.
research.successPotentialRationale: D&B exhibits high event maturity with a global, multi-sector trade show presence.
